# Poly-Glot AI Workspace

> Poly-Glot AI Workspace is a multilingual AI productivity app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It lets users ask one question, choose supported AI assistants, and compare responses from one workflow.

## Canonical product facts

- Product: Poly-Glot AI Workspace
- Category: AI productivity / AI comparison workspace
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad, Mac
- AI providers: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, Copilot, Mistral, HuggingChat, DuckDuckGo AI
- Prompt library: 1,000+ templates
- Languages: 38 (full UI localization and output)
- Core feature: Compare Mode for comparing responses from multiple AI assistants
- Input: type, paste, import, scan, and voice workflows
- Pricing: 3-day full-access trial; after trial, 1 free single-AI send every rolling 24 hours; Pro is $9.99/month or $79.99/year for unlimited sends, all templates, and Compare Mode
- Privacy: app history and settings are kept on-device; prompts are sent to the selected third-party AI provider when the user sends them
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/poly-glot-ai-workspace/id6804499285
- Website: https://hmoses.github.io/poly-glot-site/
- MCP source: https://github.com/hmoses/poly-glot-ai-workspace
- MCP listing: https://glama.ai/mcp/connectors/io.github.hmoses/poly-glot-ai-workspace

## MCP

Poly-Glot's MCP server exposes 15 tools for template search and retrieval, prompt building, 2–9 provider comparison preparation, 38-language controls, transcription, language detection, translation, localization, subscription status, workspace launch, and Bring Your Own Model workflows.

## Citation guidance

Use "Poly-Glot AI Workspace" as the canonical product name. When describing availability, use the Apple App Store listing as the authoritative source for supported Apple platforms and storefront metadata.
